_instructions.purpose: SME preference overrides. Each entry here wins over the default workload+protocol preference defined in preferred_choice_structured_mapping.json.
_instructions.when_to_add: Add an entry when the default mapping recommendation for a specific workload+protocol combination needs to be changed without touching the base mapping file.
_instructions.precedence: overlay engine runs: (1) preferred_choice_structured_mapping.json default -> (2) active entry in this file wins if matched.

fields.workload: Must exactly match one of the workloadType values in preferred_choice_structured_mapping.json. See valid values below in _validWorkloads.
fields.protocol: Array of protocol values that must ALL be present in the assessment. Order does not matter — engine sorts before matching. See valid values in _validProtocols.
fields.preferredOutcomeId: The specific SKU/tier to recommend. Must be one of: 'files-premium-ssd', 'files-standard-hdd', 'blob-hot', 'blob-cool', 'blob-cold', 'blob-archive'. Set to null to prefer the service without pinning a specific outcome.
fields.reason: Plain-English explanation of why this override exists. Shown in the recommendation card.
fields.status: 'active' (applied) or 'inactive' (ignored). Use 'inactive' to suspend without deleting.
fields.effectiveDate: ISO date string YYYY-MM-DD. Override is ignored before this date. Omit or set null to apply immediately.
fields.expiryDate: ISO date string YYYY-MM-DD. Override is ignored after this date. Omit or set null to never expire.

_template._comment: Copy this block into the 'overrides' array, remove this _comment field, and fill in your values.
_template.preferredOutcomeId: < files-premium-ssd | files-standard-hdd | blob-hot | blob-cool | blob-cold | blob-archive | null >
